lines.text: description: Connects Deck Apps to a nearby computer with VitaDeck Host Control. Runs and links the Host Companion (vitadeck-host-companion), installs .vdplugin packages, and writes Host Control Plugins with a Deck App or standalone. Use when a Deck App should read or control a Mac, Windows or Linux computer, or when the user mentions Host Control, the Host Companion, vitadeck-host-companion, host plugins, .vdplugin, systemStats, linking a computer, or errors like not_linked, unknown_plugin, unreachable or forbidden.

lines.text: 1. Install the companion with Node.js 24: `npm install -g @vitadeck/host-companion`. It is not on npm yet; from a VitaDeck checkout, `pnpm --dir js host-companion <command>` runs the same CLI.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: docs(skills): add vitadeck-host-control and cover Host Control in the others
lines.text: 2. Start it with `vitadeck-host-companion start`, which serves port 8797, and allow incoming connections at the firewall prompt.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: feat(shell): one LAN Listener for upload and link, on from startup
lines.text: 3. On VitaDeck, press Start (F1 on the desktop host) and note the address under **Upload and link**. VitaDeck listens from startup on port 8787, for uploads and links alike.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: feat(shell): one LAN Listener for upload and link, on from startup
lines.text: 4. On the computer, run `vitadeck-host-companion link <address>`. Link more computers the same way; VitaDeck keeps up to 4. **Host Control** in the Shell lists them and forgets one on Cross.

lines.text: - For things that happen on the computer (an alert, a build finishing), watch events instead of polling: `useEffect(() => watchHostEvents(plugin, (event) => ..., { hostId }), [hostId])`. Each event arrives within about one round trip. `core`'s `notice` events come from `vitadeck-host-companion notify "text"`, so any script can reach Deck Apps.

lines.text: - **`host/plugin.ts`** declares the commands with `defineHostPlugin(id, { name: command<Payload, Result>(guard) })`. Deck Apps bundle it, so it must not import Node.js modules. The id defaults to the project slug.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: docs(skills): add vitadeck-host-control and cover Host Control in the others
lines.text: - **`host/companion.ts`** default-exports `implementHostPlugin(plugin, { name: (payload) => result })` and runs in the companion with Node.js. `tsc -p host` fails on a missing or mistyped command. Throw `new HostCommandError("unsupported_platform", "...")` to answer with a specific code.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: feat(host-control): computers push events to Deck Apps by long-polling
lines.text: - **Events:** declare them in `defineHostPlugin(id, commands, { name: event<Data>() })` and emit them from `implementHostPlugin(plugin, impls, { start: (emit) => { ...; return stop; } })`. `start` runs while the plugin is loaded, including after each reload.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: docs(skills): add vitadeck-host-control and cover Host Control in the others
lines.text: - **`vitadeck.config.json`** holds `"hostPlugin": { "entry": "./host/companion.ts", "files": "./host/files" }`.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: docs(skills): add vitadeck-host-control and cover Host Control in the others
lines.text: - `files` is optional. Read those files with `new URL("./files/x", import.meta.url)` when a command runs, not at module load.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: docs(skills): add vitadeck-host-control and cover Host Control in the others
lines.text: - The zip drops file modes, so run a shipped script through its interpreter (`execFile("sh", [path])`).

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: docs(skills): add vitadeck-host-control and cover Host Control in the others
lines.text: - **A standalone plugin's `package.json`** exports `host/plugin.ts` and takes `@vitadeck/sdk` as a peer dependency. A Deck App adds it as a dependency (`pnpm add ../lights`, a git URL, or npm once `"private": true` is removed), then runs `import { hostPlugin as lights } from "lights"`.
